gitignore_write.scope: scripts/worktree_convention.py ensure-ignore --apply may append one planned <root>/ line to the repository-root .gitignore after this-turn authorization. It must not stage, commit, delete, or reorder existing rules.
gitignore_write.reason: A tracked ignore rule is required so worktree contents cannot enter history. Apply is opt-in and restores previous bytes on failure.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must require authorization before file write.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash may run the helper; --apply still requires this-turn authorization.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to rewrite .gitignore.

git_worktree_add.scope: Execute only the argv from plan-create when ok_to_create is true: git worktree add -b <branch> <path> <start-point>.
git_worktree_add.reason: MVP creates only a new branch in a planned ignored path.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must authorize the git subprocess.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash is declared; still require ok_to_create before execution.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to create worktrees.

git_worktree_remove.scope: Execute only the argv from plan-remove when ok_to_remove is true. Refuse dirty, locked, in-progress, submodule, unowned, or unregistered paths.
git_worktree_remove.reason: Removal discards a checkout and must stay owner-scoped.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must authorize removal.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash is declared; still require ok_to_remove.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to remove worktrees.

git_worktree_prune.scope: The helper may run git worktree prune --dry-run. A real prune requires this-turn authorization after the candidate list is shown.
git_worktree_prune.reason: prune is repository-global and can drop metadata for worktrees this skill did not create.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must authorize prune separately from list.
target_enforcement.claude: Bash is declared; still require displayed candidates plus authorization.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is not authorization to prune worktrees.
